title: Post-Residency Fee Days Deducted on the Entrance Fee Agreement Closing-Year Tax Letter
content:
On the closing-year tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, the independent living fees billed for the days after the residency ended are the estate's expense, not the resident's: where the paired independent living residency ended on the resident's death, the post-death fee days of that apartment type are deducted, and where it ended on a transfer to Larkspur assisted living or memory care, the internal transfer notice days of that apartment type are deducted; each deducted day is the residency's monthly service fee divided by 30, the deduction rounded to the cent half up and taken from the independent living amount before the percentage applies, the result never below 0.00; otherwise nothing is deducted.

## Records read

The **Independent Living Residency Agreement** paired with the Entrance Fee Agreement: how it ended (death, transfer to assisted living, transfer to memory care, or otherwise), its apartment type, and its monthly service fee. The post-death fee days and the internal transfer notice days are the figures the Independent Living Residency Agreement terms set for that apartment type.

## Deduction ladder

| Paired independent living residency ended on | Days deducted |
|---|---|
| The resident's death | The post-death fee days of the apartment type |
| A transfer to Larkspur assisted living or memory care | The internal transfer notice days of the apartment type |
| Any other ending | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical monthly service fee 4655.00)

| Days deducted | Monthly fee multiplied by the days and divided by 30 | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 1086.1666 | 1086.17 |
| 30 | 4655.00 | 4655.00 |

With an independent living amount of 25200.00 and a deduction of 1086.17, the amount the percentage applies to is 24113.83. With an independent living amount of 900.00 and a deduction of 1086.17, it is 0.00.
